title: Polite and Formal Recommendations
goal: Recommend things politely with se recomienda que and sería conveniente que.

items: I can recommend politely with se recomienda que and se sugiere que.
I can soften a recommendation with sería conveniente que and the imperfect subjunctive.
I can use the new words for recommending.
